Questions

What does “Backend and API development” cost?
The MVP costs $9,000–18,000 (UZS 108–220 mln), the full version $25,000–60,000 (UZS 300–725 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Backend and API development” take?
The MVP takes 6–10 weeks, the full version 14–24 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Access to servers and accounts; A description of the current system; A technical contact.
